message.text: The store package contains the Go structs that map to the `user`, `attachment`, and `reaction` tables.

q15.

user: User — store/user.go  
attachment: Attachment — store/attachment.go  
reaction: Reaction — store/reaction.go  

These structs are defined in the `store` package and are used by the database drivers when reading and writing the matching tables (for example in `store/db/sqlite/user.go`, `store/db/sqlite/attachment.go`, and `store/db/sqlite/reaction.go`). The tables themselves are defined in `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql`.
